    Fix log · v1.76.14

    Phased depths · what this line sealed.

    P0 every screen opens · P1 every door · P2 every save · P3 every sheet · P4 seat gates · P5 corrupt store.

    1. v1.76.13 — Thank sheet closes (X + backdrop). Show FAB above footer. Tracker panes expand below doors. Footer order Cal|Tracker. Mode-chat hidden on walk. Footer tabs hardened. Chat = Inbox threads.
    2. v1.70.22 — Onboarding footer sealed off until Enter. Tracker Probation map. Chat coach short replies. New group sheet visible. SEATS product list.
    3. v1.70.21 — Guided Stream Send sat under footer/FAB. Composer now sits above the bar. Work compose lands in the COO thread.
    4. v1.70.19 — Guided Stream 1→5 now appears immediately; empty state no longer covers the cards.
    5. Final — New 1:1 cannot open yourself; EA / Lead / HR chats are seeded. Investigate drafts notify COO. Layout sheet pills apply.
    6. P6 Footer — seven tabs were 7px type (.46rem). They looked gone. Now 11px, 56px tall, safe-area.
    7. P6 Phone — long-hold, new group, composer, More, investigate, confirm delivery all land on 390px. No sideways scroll.
    8. P1 More — boot JS deleted the More tab. Restored.
    9. P1 Work — M/W/F and House documents rows now open their tools.
    10. P0 Thread — empty thread bounce back to Inbox (no blank chat).
    11. P2 Thanks — seat list excludes you; send no longer dies on “thank yourself”.
    12. P4 Stakeholders — only CEO sees Confirm seal.
    13. Inbox wipe — FQ / Pulse / EOD saved notices into Chat’s inbox. COO threads vanished. Notices now live apart; save merges by id.
    14. COO send — hardened store + thread id so 1:1 actually lands.
    15. Show FAB — visible in chat / thread; drag + persist.
    16. Long-hold — Task / Document / @Lodeneom now send a receipt in-thread, not just prefill.
    17. Feedback — tap opens thread; draft + CEO seal on the card (no phone prompt).
    18. Deliver — submit read cards not old table rows. Custom row always available. Confirm / send-back persist.
    19. Attach — file is read (text / image) and stored on the message; Lodeneom DM / @ mention feeds Guided Stream.
    20. Stakeholders — Confirm digest now seals and notifies COO (was toast-only).
    21. Help tutorials — stay inside L_OS.
    22. Agenda — empty success / vertical no longer block save; house defaults applied.

    Formal Query

    Lean room · W2-5 / Harvest. Who may post: CEO · EA · HR. 48h Response · silence = Default still counts. Base pay never reduced. ×3 if Standards Governor is subject.

    Phase-1: localStorage only. Email notifications = Phase-2.

    Revision Request

    W1-5 · Anyone may raise. Seal-holder decides ≤5 working days. Decline needs a written reason. Naming the raiser in the sealed version is recognition. Base pay never touched.

    Silence past day 5 is a red on the seal-holder · Promise Accuracy. Chat Fill can draft this form.

    Suspension

    Protective · temporary · max 14 calendar days. Base pay protected. Awards freeze for duration. Visible only CEO · COO · HR · EA. Fruit / probation clock pause if applicable.

    CEO confirms within 24h if not initiator · silence keeps Suspension in force. Review before day 14.
